integrity: Self-contained proof and finite rational checker accompany the statement. Source dates refer to original public problem evidence, not this manuscript.
scientific_limitations: Classification is limited to positive exponents and three-prime supports {5,7,r} with r>7 prime; no other prime supports or complete global solution set are treated. Infinitude uses Dirichlet theorem. Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Two prime-progressions classify arithmetic-derivative–totient coincidences with support \(\{5,7,r\}\)
